Espurr

Psychic

Kalos · Generation 6

Espurr is a Psychic-type Restraint Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 3.5 kg. It evolves into Meowstic. Its highest base stat is Speed (68), with a base stat total of 355.
